schema.description: A quantity held out of usable stock (ADR 0052). It has no bin and no usable quantity, and can never be reserved.

state.description: HELD while waiting for a decision; REMOVED once a final disposition settled it.

receiptId.description: The inbound receipt the quantity came from.

ownerRef.description: Owner of the stock; absent for fleet-owned stock.

sscc.description: The carton SSCC of the line, when it had one.

lpns.description: License plates of the Damaged cartons of the line (marks only; they carry no quantity).

disposition.description: The last decision, once there is one.

reworkCount.description: How many times the unit was sent to REWORK.

schema.title: HeldUnit

404.description: No held unit has this id.

schema.description: RFC 7807 (Problem Details for HTTP APIs) error shape, used for every non-2xx response across this service. `type` is `https://errors.inventory-storage.warehouse-systems.dev/<slug>`; every slug is documented as a response example on the operation(s) that can return it, and the mapping from typed domain error to (status, slug, title) lives in one lookup table (`problemCatalog` in internal/adapters/inbound/http/errors.go, ADR 0005).

type.description: A URI identifying the error category (does not need to resolve). Unique per distinct error category in this service.

title.description: Fixed, human-readable summary of the error category.

status.description: Duplicates the HTTP status code as an integer (RFC 7807 requirement).

detail.description: The specific error message for this occurrence.

instance.description: The request path that produced this error.
